# Bars & Nightlife

When the sun goes down, the fun continues in Pittsburgh!

Looking for evening adventures while you’re in town? Whether you’re seeking an upscale nightclub, a local bar to catch the game or an entertainment destination with a number of options in on one place, Pittsburgh has something for you – all within walking distance or a short shared ride away from hotels. 

## Casinos

Located on Pittsburgh’s North Shore, Rivers Casino is open 24 hours a day and offers many entertainment options beyond its 3,000 slot machines and 86 table games. Happy hour, live entertainment, dancing and dining can be enjoyed as well as entertainment at the 1,000-seat riverside amphitheater.
